rows.title: CT projects $210M Medicaid cost overruns, challenging spending
rows.standfirst: CT’s projected Medicaid cost overruns create challenges for lawmakers hoping to boost payments to doctors who treat low-income patients.

rows.title: CT makes 11.5% return on pension asset investments
rows.standfirst: Connecticut made an 11.5% return last year investing its pension assets, placing in the top 25% nationally of large public pension funds.

rows.title: GOP leader presses AG to rule on CT budget dispute
rows.standfirst: Months after CT Democrats left key accounts underfunded, Republicans are still waiting for an opinion on whether the process was legal.

rows.title: CT Energy Assistance Program at risk of collapse, distributors say
rows.standfirst: A program vital to keeping vulnerable citizens warm is costing distributors money and needs immediate reform, industry officials say.

rows.title: AG: CT legislature didn’t violate law by not adjusting budget
rows.standfirst: CT Attorney General William Tong said it was OK for the legislature to not adjust the budget in May, but Republicans warn of its impact.

rows.title: CT’s pension costs still higher than most of the nation
rows.standfirst: Despite CT pouring billions of surplus dollars into pension funds and scoring investment returns, the benefits’ cost here remains high.
